# One Trait to Rule Them All

**Version 2.9.2** · for Crusader Kings III 1.20.* · [Steam Workshop](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2245233173) · [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md) · [All versions](https://github.com/nchelix/ck3-mods-public/releases?q=one-trait&expanded=true)

One panel, no menu. Twenty-one trait cheats, tabs to rule any character, and a
wonder of its own.
Everything you have ever wanted to do to a Crusader Kings save, in one place.

---

## How it works

1. Right-click any character, including yourself, and choose **One Trait**:
  the panel opens on them at once. Or click the round **One Trait** button
  beside your portrait to open it on yourself.
1. **The One Trait panel**, on whoever you opened it for. **Traits**,
  **Sanctum** and **Army**: every power a row you switch On or Off with
  one click. **Character**: five tabs. **Realm**: eight tabs for any
  landed character, from government (any of fifteen) to **Court**.
  **Puppets**. **Diplomacy**: five tabs.
1. A greyed row says why on hover. Permanent actions ask for a second click.

## What is in the cabinet

**The character themselves**

- **Unlimited Wealth** — income and tax tripled, gold pouring in; and
  **Unlimited Fame** — prestige, renown, piety, legitimacy, influence, merit
- **Chosen of God** — perfect spiritual fulfillment, four personal tenets,
  piety that pays in every skill, and religion that costs nothing
- **Boosted Stats**, and **Supreme Learner** for pouring lifestyle
  experience
- **Unnatural Long Life** — immune to plague and disease, a century more
  of life — or full **Immortality**
- **Completely Loveable** — nobody can dislike you, and your legends spread
  like wildfire
- **Unlimited Dread** — everybody is terrified of you, and tyranny costs
  nothing
- **No Stress**, **Physical Giant**, and **Endless Fertility**
  (children with the good genes, never the inbreeding) or **Celibacy**

**Ruling and war**

- **Supreme Manager of the Realm** — control, development, climbing court
  grandeur, artifacts that never decay, free titles; and **Master Builder** —
  every building at once, for nothing
- **Supreme Domain** — hold as much land as you please
- **Supreme Commander** — unbeatable in battle, an army that costs nothing
  to raise or keep, free landings, safe roads
- **The Army of the One** — Legion, Bowmen and Riders, free to recruit or
  raised from the Army tab at a **Count** you set, in three strengths
  (Godlike, Elite, Regular) — plus **Tireless** (kept supplied) and **Swift Armies**, **Unlimited** and **Free Men at
  Arms**, **Unlimited** and **Extremely Effective Knights**
- **The Wars of the One** — five casus belli, free and needing no border:
  **Conquest** of any title at any tier, **Subjugation** of a whole realm,
  **Tribute**, **Ransom** for gold, hooks and prisoners, and a lightning
  **Blitz**
- **Ultimate Schemer** — your schemes, contracts and plots always succeed,
  instantly and unseen; agents always join; nobody's scheme against you can win
- **Marry** any of your family to any of theirs; **Give a title** from the
  right-click list

**The Diplomacy category** — five tabs, between you and anyone else

- **Alliances**: ally with them, inherit their alliances, isolate them,
  end an alliance
- **Vassals**: make them your vassal or tributary, or release them, without
  a war; or become *their* vassal or tributary, or break free
- **War & Peace**: white peace, win every war between you outright,
  five-year truces
- **Relations**: a strong hook, a friend, a best friend, end a rivalry,
  adoration
- **Hostility**: strike them dead, imprison
  or free them, banish them, excommunicate them or lift it

**Court and Puppets**

- **Court** (Realm tab): summon a master Chancellor, Marshal, Steward,
  Spymaster or Court Chaplain, a champion, a spouse candidate or a gifted ward
  into the court of whoever the panel is open on, yourself or another ruler, with
  their culture and faith. Master councillors take their seat at once, where the realm has one.
- **Puppet Master** (Puppets tab): make any ruler your puppet, or any clergy
  your Clerical Ruler or Realm Priest Puppet, whatever your faith, and release
  them again; then act through them from the game's own puppets row.

**The Character category** — five tabs in the panel, for you or anyone

- **Stats**: age, gold, court grandeur, influence, merit, legitimacy,
  prestige, piety, renown and stress, stepped up or down
- **Identity**: swap culture and faith with the character or take their
  capital's; reroll their name or give them yours
- **Traits & Looks**: perfect genetics, a full cleanse of disease and
  injury, personality copied either way, every bad coping habit broken,
  hereditary looks copied either way
- **Family**: designate them your heir, adopt them into your house,
  disown them, bring them to your court
- **Legacy**: become a mythical legend, accolade glory, a relic; canonize
  departed kin as saints, named where the game knows them

**For nomads and wanderers**

- **Blessing of the Horde** — vast herds and pastures that never wear
  out — and **The Wanderer's Road** — fast, safe travel for anyone and a camp
  that never runs short for landless adventurers

**Realm events** — in the panel's Realm category

- Fill or drain the herd, upgrade the domicile, end the Iberian and Persian
  struggles, release every tributary, unleash a plague on a county you choose
- **Become a Conqueror**: starts the game's own conquest, with vassals
  offering armies and the conqueror's casus belli; or as the **Scourge of the
  Gods**. **End the conquest** stops it with no penalty.

**Buildings**

- **The Sanctum of the One**: a wonder only One Trait can raise. Its county
  cannot be taken, and on the panel it wakes eleven powers one by one — the
  realm builds itself, a golden age, one faith and one people, every secret and
  scheme laid bare, a hook on every vassal, no factions, a relic every year, a
  hall of champions, ever-full armies, and tribute from every ruler in the
  world. Each power reports in your message feed when it acts, and **Invoke
  every awakened power now** runs them all at once. It passes to your heir and
  never replaces a wonder already standing.

## Built for the game as it is now

First released in 2020, now wired into every system added since, up to
By God Alone.

Every icon is original artwork made for this mod.

## Things to know

- **Almost everything is reversible.** Traits can be removed, blessings
  revoked, the conquest ended, and resources drained. The few permanent options
  ask you to confirm with a second click.
- **The plague cannot be undone.** There is no cure in this game: once you
  unleash it on a county, it stays.
- **The AI never uses any of it on its own.** Make a rival a Conqueror,
  though, and they will act like one.

## Compatibility

- Built and tested against **CK3 1.20 "Crozier"** and By God Alone.
- **Achievements** are disabled, which is rather the point.
- Adds its own traits, buildings, regiments, casus belli and puppet types, and
  overwrites no base game file.
- Safe to add mid-game. Remove the traits and disband any One Trait army
  before removing the mod.

## Languages

All nine game languages; the other eight show English text until translated.

## Install

- **Steam Workshop:** subscribe on the Workshop page above.
- **Manually, any version:** download `one-trait-v<version>.zip` from the [releases](https://github.com/nchelix/ck3-mods-public/releases?q=one-trait&expanded=true) and extract it into `Documents/Paradox Interactive/Crusader Kings III/mod/`, then enable it in the launcher.
